translations.translatedText: # Thursday 9.12.2021 (radio)
Corona infections. Home care for older people. Maternity package. Weather forecast.
## Corona infections

![A Covid-19 patient was treated in an intensive care unit in Brussels last week. According to the WHO forecast, the number of deaths and of people needing intensive care will rise greatly in the coming months.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_295/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-883448619e46936c343/1637762824)
Open image viewer
Intensive care needs a lot of nurses. Photo: Stephanie Lecocq / EPA
Corona infections are increasing.
On Thursday there were 1781 new corona infections in Finland. That is more than ever before in one day.
There are also more corona patients in intensive care than before. Intensive care needs a lot of nurses and equipment.
There are corona patients in intensive care all over the country. Now, for the first time, there are more of them outside the Helsinki region than in it.
## Home care for older people

![Basic nurse Minna Kumpumäki on a home care visit to a client.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6240,h_3510,x_0,y_556/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7147005f4f95a1a70ad/1609260956)
Open image viewer
More nurses are needed for home care for older people. Photo: Tanja Kröger / Yle
Home care for older people is to be improved.
On Thursday the government gave Parliament a proposal on how home care will be reformed.
The aim is to make sure that an older person gets the home care that has been promised to them in their plan.
The government proposes, for example, that an older person can also get home care at night. There must also be enough workers in home care.
The government's proposal has been criticised because it does not say how more workers will be found for older people's home care. There are far too few nurses in the sector today.
## Maternity package
![Maternity package 2022](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4900,h_2756,x_0,y_413/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-88917161af785b5adfc/1639033445)
Open image viewer
The box of the maternity package can be used as a baby's cot. Photo: Janne Lindroos / Yle
Kela has presented the new maternity package. The maternity package has clothes and supplies for the baby.
This year the maternity package has 43 products. That is 7 products fewer than last year.
Kela's benefits chief Johanna Aholainen says that this year quality products were wanted for the package. For example, organic cotton has been used for the clothes.
Kela also held a vote on what kind of sleeping bag and outdoor overall will be in the maternity package. The winners were the Norppa sleeping bag and the Muumi overall.
All the products are packed in a box, which can be used as a baby's cot. This year the mattress box has pictures of Finnish animals. The designer of the pictures is the Japanese Aya Iwaya.
The maternity package is an old Finnish invention. Maternity packages have been given to families for 84 years already.
## Weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12223562)
Open image viewer
On Friday the weather warms across the whole country. The frost is no longer as hard as in recent days.
The temperature on Friday is mostly between -10 and -15 degrees. It is mildest in the west.
Snowfall arrives in southern and western Finland. In a large part of the country, however, it is dry.
On Saturday the temperature in the south is around zero. That is why there may be freezing sleet mixed with the snowfall.
